LCOM-STLCOMP.description: Steel Composite Load Combination (LCOM-STLCOMP). One entry per combination id; each combination carries a list of (load case, factor) terms in vCOMB, and the summation method is driven by iTYPE.

NO.description: [ReadOnly] Combination number/id, assigned by the program. Ignored on write.

NAME.description: Combination name. Must be unique when adding a new combination.

ACTIVE.description: Active type of the combination. Typical values: "ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "STRENGTH", "SERVICE". Converted internally via the active-type map.

bES.description: Elastic-stage flag (E). Applies only to the Concrete load-combination type; ignored for the STLCOMP (steel composite) type.

bCB.description: [ReadOnly] Min/max/combination result-type flag derived by the program (General: false, Min/Max/All: true). Ignored on write.

iTYPE.description: Summation method. Add: 0, Envelope: 1, ABS: 2, SRSS: 3.

iSERV_TYPE.description: EC service type code. Reserved/unused on the write path in the current handler.

nLCOMTYPE.description: EC load-combination type code. Reserved/unused on the write path in the current handler.

nSEISTYPE.description: EC seismic type code. Reserved/unused on the write path in the current handler.

vCOMB.description: List of combination terms. Each term references a load case by analysis type and name with a scaling factor.

ANAL.description: Analysis type of the referenced load case (case-insensitive). ST: Static, RS: Response Spectrum, TH: Time History, MV: Moving Load, SM: Settlement, ENVL: Envelope, CB: General Combination, CS: Construction Stage, ES: Elastic Stage, and related CB*/N* variants.

LCNAME.description: Load case name. Must resolve to an existing load case of the given ANAL type.

FACTOR.description: Scale factor applied to the referenced load case.
